## 简体中文

- 优化 Mermaid 连线文字：字号略小于节点文字，横向连线文字显示在线条上方并留出间距，竖向分支文字上移，改善与拐弯横线重叠的问题；不再添加遮挡连线的文字背景框。
- 优化长连线标签的可用宽度与换行，修复包含换行符的 Markdown 标签测量不准确、文字被节点遮挡的问题。
- 修复时序图黄色注释区域未完整覆盖文字的问题；长注释按可用宽度换行并预留高度，跨参与者注释充分利用横向空间，消息文字与横线的间距更加紧凑。
- 修复 Word SVG 导出中节点内单行、多行文字未垂直居中的问题，保留 SVG 矢量清晰度，并同步改善预览与导出的连线文字布局。

## English

- Improve Mermaid edge labels with a smaller font than node labels, a small gap above horizontal connectors, and raised labels on vertical branches to reduce overlap with bends. Remove label boxes that covered connectors.
- Give long edge labels more room before wrapping and fix Markdown labels with escaped line breaks being measured incorrectly or covered by nodes.
- Keep sequence diagram notes fully inside their yellow backgrounds. Wrap long notes with reserved vertical space, use the available width for notes spanning participants, and place message text closer to its horizontal line.
- Fix vertical centering of single-line and multiline node text in Word SVG exports while preserving vector sharpness, and improve edge label placement in previews and exports.
